title: Your possible world
description: 这个世界由当前布局中的 3 个 unit 生成，覆盖 1 个高度层，最高达到 Z=0.0。水、火、土先生成自然地形基底：土 1、水 1、火 1。动物作为高阶生命元素，只在自然基底上形成较小范围的生态痕迹：无。实体结构主要停留在低层，地貌更接近底面分布。主要区域关系为：central region 的自然基底为 火，生命覆盖为 无，形成 fire-shaped lava, scorched land, volcanic cracks, or heated rock；central region 的自然基底为 水，生命覆盖为 无，形成 water-shaped basins, rivers, lakes, or wetlands；central region 的自然基底为 土，生命覆盖为 无，形成 earth-shaped ground, hills, rock, grassland, or mountain ridges。综合地貌特征包括：fire-shaped lava, scorched land, volcanic cracks, or heated rock、water-shaped basins, rivers, lakes, or wetlands、earth-shaped ground, hills, rock, grassland, or mountain ridges。

terrainGrammar.base_description: Earth dominates the bottom layer, so the base world is land. Small water becomes lakes, ponds, rivers, or wetlands. Small fire becomes scorched land, volcanic cracks, or burnt areas.
terrain_features: 1 fire unit(s) read as scorched land, volcanic cracks, or burnt areas inside land
1 water unit(s) read as lakes, ponds, rivers, or wetlands inside land
